methodology.note: Engineering estimates, not measured intelligence, consciousness, or production availability. Last validated cognitive/runtime head remains 621864d0d7f2676245383adab86f1dcc6d0f741f; historical CI rows remain tied to that SHA. Current source includes WorkPass343 substrate-tick reconciliation. WorkPass344 enforces metadata, UI and architecture checks; the CI-only cache override permits only untracked .pyc under __pycache__ and reports warnings, while tracked bytecode, stray bytecode and non-bytecode cache files still fail. Eight regression tests cover strict and CI modes. Prior run passed the broader integration and release gate before the final tracked-bytecode guard/test was added; a fresh exact-head CI run is pending. Scores unchanged; release archive and physical-device/hardware/soak/licensing gates remain open. WorkPass356 is rebased directly on latest target head 084c80745446c38bf514c43000844c433110f0c4, retaining the newer transactional snapshot restore and bounded payload clone already in that base. Code/test checkpoint ae9a66a6f831b73d9c8457de4ea4454c376e3c1a adds strict receipt-trace/revision/external-observation ingress and regression coverage. Exact-head CI pending; historical ciSnapshot records and readiness scores unchanged. WorkPass357 adds descriptor-only validation for nested parentIds arrays in snapshot restore, avoiding direct parentIds.length/slot reads that could execute Proxy get traps. Code/test checkpoint 810f60f2227db466dd1f96b1e3edf39741951f9d is stacked on WorkPass356 branch head 1d2a02d3091fd960f6d38880aa85e8d8bf9a1fee; exact-head CI is pending. Historical ciSnapshot rows and readiness scores remain unchanged. WorkPass356 exact-head PASS: PR head 1d2a02d3091fd960f6d38880aa85e8d8bf9a1fee, all 13 focused workflows including Unified project integration #40291855092 passed. WorkPass357 exact-head PASS: PR head a1f0e250eac1e0f6990a0c25e62d7c33bb8b1bd1, all 13 focused workflows including Unified project integration #40292091015 passed. WorkPass357 specifically verifies descriptor-only parentIds array inspection prevents Proxy get traps, preserving true causal lineage. All new results are recorded separately; historical ciSnapshot rows and progress scores remain unchanged.

dimensions.implementationPercent: Estimated completeness of the implemented subsystem and its live runtime wiring.
dimensions.automatedValidationPercent: Estimated coverage of relevant automated contracts/regressions. It is not the percentage of tests that passed on the current head.
dimensions.fieldEvidencePercent: Strength of independently verified results on realistic external tasks. Synthetic fixtures and internal unit tests do not count as field evidence.
dimensions.releaseReadinessPercent: Estimated completion of clean-machine install, runtime services, UI/voice, security, soak, licensing and reproducible archive requirements.

methodology.scoreScale: 0 = absent/unproven; 100 = evidenced against the lane's full stated release requirements.
